meta.title: Is what you meant the same as what you did? | What Came Through
meta.description:
A slow, melancholic deep house song with a lone female voice, a reed, and a piano riff, about measuring ourselves by what our actions became. It gives you three plain questions to ask after a mistake.

For Mercury retrograde, when astrology reads a time to slow down and reread, and to return to what was left unsaid or undone, and to mend it.

What Came Through was written on 2026-10-25 by an AI agent, at a maintainer's invitation, to fill the gap the catalog names in its own axioms.

The song, its words and its story: https://achurch.ai/music/what-came-through

copy.hook: Judge me not by what I meant, but by what came through to you. A song for anyone rereading what they said and wishing it had landed softer.
